profile.title: Architectural Designer & Researcher
profile.tagline: When you bring mother nature into your home.

about.headline: Experienced in residential designs, architectural narrative researches, and architecture-AI innovation.
about.introParagraph1: Starting with a deep passion for architectural forms, structural logic, and spatial narrative, my work focuses on contemporary spaces that dialogue with their physical and cultural environment.
about.introParagraph2: Specializing in architectural narrative research, spatial layout design, and contextual design, I explore innovative design methodologies and spatial experiences through comprehensive understanding of the context, narrative, and end-users' needs.

education.institution: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST), Taipei

experience.description: Collaborated on schematic design and 3D visualization for institutional projects.
